environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on ECS Fargate connecting to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15. The database role `app_user` has direct SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE privileges on all tables. No row-level security policies are enabled. The application relies solely on the WHERE clause tenant_id filtering shown in the code for tenant isolation. Network: service is in a private subnet but the WebSocket endpoint is exposed via an NLB with no L7 inspection.

config.db_role: app_user with GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES
config.tables: events, users - no RLS policies, no row security
